item.description:
## Summary - Removed the `powerNotch` target membership exception on `PowerNotchWidgets` in `project.pbxproj` so `AIUsageWidgetIntents.swift`, `AIUsageWidgetModels.swift`, and `PowerNotchWidgets.swift` are no longer compiled into the main `powerNotch.app` target (eliminating duplicate `Metadata.appintents/extract.actionsdata` in `powerNotch.app`). - Added a standalone, non-shipped `PowerNotchWidgetsPreviewHost` macOS app target (`SKIP_INSTALL = YES`, `WIDGET_PREVIEW_HOST` compilation condition) for live Xcode Canvas `#Preview` rendering and standalone interactive widget previews without polluting `powerNotch.app` or Release archives. - Added `#if WIDGET_PREVIEW_HOST` preview store hooks and `PowerNotchWidgetsPreviewGalleryView` so Small / Medium / Large widgets can be previewed side-by-side with working in-widget `AppIntent` buttons (paging, chart range/metric switching, refresh) and Sample / Live / Empty / Dark / Light toggles.
## Verification - Built `PowerNotchWidgetsPreviewHost` scheme with 0 errors and verified Xcode Canvas `RenderPreview` on `PowerNotchWidgets.swift` (`Large · Interactive`). - Built `powerNotch` scheme with 0 errors and confirmed `powerNotch.app` contains neither `Metadata.appintents` nor `PowerNotchWidgetsPreviewHost`, while `PowerNotchWidgetsExtension.appex` retains `Metadata.appintents/extract.actionsdata`. - Passed `.github/scripts/tests` and `swift test` (121 tests / 17 suites).
